question: The ratio of boys to girls in a college is 2 : 3. If 15% of the boys and 25% of the girls hold scholarships, what percentage of the students do not hold a scholarship?
solution: Take 200 boys and 300 girls. Scholarships: 30 + 75 = 105 out of 500, i.e. 21%. Without = 100 − 21 = 79%.
